categories.main_business_segments: The company operates as a professional eyeglass retail chain enterprise with six main brands: President optical (high-end customization), Doctor Glasses (professional vision care), Boojing (new consumer retail), zèle (fashion quick consumption), Concrete (national franchise), and ZORRO (retro cultural theme). The company provides optical eyeglasses, smart eyeglasses, finished eyewear products, contact lenses, and eye health peripheral products through both direct and franchise channels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in professional optometry and eyeglass fitting services, utilizing advanced optical equipment and testing instruments. Core capabilities include optical lens design and selection, professional vision testing and prescription services, eyeglass assembly and customization, and digital supply chain management. The company partners with leading lens manufacturers like Carl Zeiss, Essilor, and Luxottica for product sourcing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves consumers across all age groups with focus on youth (myopia management), working adults (digital eye protection), and elderly customers (presbyopia solutions). Primary customer segments include students, office workers, and seniors. End markets include optical retail, medical institutions, shopping malls, and e-commerce platforms. The company also serves B2B customers through franchise partnerships.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across 25 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities in China, with major presence in East China (Zhejiang, Shanghai, Jiangsu), South China (Guangdong, Hainan), Southwest China (Sichuan, Yunnan, Chongqing), and other regions. The company also maintains overseas operations through subsidiaries in Hong Kong. Core markets are concentrated in first and second-tier cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the downstream segment of the eyeglass industry value chain, functioning as a professional retail distributor and service provider. The company sources finished products and components from upstream manufacturers and suppliers, then provides direct-to-consumer retail services and professional vision care solutions. The company also operates an upstream-facing B2B platform (Jingglian) for franchise partner supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: digital transformation and omnichannel integration, smart eyeglass ecosystem development through partnerships with tech companies like Rabird Innovation and XREAL, functional lens product expansion (myopia management, progressive lenses, blue light protection), professional service capability enhancement through staff certification programs, and silver economy market development targeting elderly consumers. R&D focuses on ERP system optimization, CRM integration, and e-commerce platform development.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through retail sales of eyeglass products (frames and lenses) and related services. Revenue streams include: direct retail sales through company-owned stores (78.49% of revenue), online e-commerce sales through multiple platforms (14.12% of revenue), and franchise/distribution channels (7.40% of revenue). Additional revenue comes from rental income from investment properties and software licensing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the first eyeglass retail chain to go public in China and maintains a leading market position. Major competitors include other large eyeglass retail chains and optical hospitals. The company differentiates through its professional vision care services, multi-brand portfolio strategy, omnichannel distribution network, and digital capabilities. The company holds strong brand recognition and market share in first and second-tier cities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large scale eyeglass retailer with 2024 revenue of 1.202 billion yuan, representing 2.29% growth year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 103.6 million yuan in 2024, down 19.08% from 2023. The company operates 557 stores (510 direct, 47 franchise) and maintains total assets of 1.253 billion yuan. The company shows stable cash generation with operating cash flow of 275.5 million yuan in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes professional vision care expertise, offering comprehensive eye health solutions across all life stages from youth myopia management to elderly presbyopia care. Key differentiators include: professional optometry and fitting services with certified staff, diverse functional lens products addressing specific vision needs, multi-brand portfolio serving different customer segments and price points, omnichannel shopping experience integrating online and offline services, and partnerships with leading international lens manufacturers ensuring product quality and innovation.
